p: in thy faithfulness answer me: That is, as you have promised to be faithful in your promise to all who trust in you.
righteousness: That is, according to your free goodness, by which you defend your own.

sight shall no man living be: He know that his afflictions were God's messengers to call him to repentance for his sins, though toward his enemies he was innocent, and in God's sight all men are sinners.
long dead: He acknowledges that God is the only and true physician and heal him: and that he is able to raise him to life, though he were dead long ago, and turned to ashes.
heart within me is desolate: So that only by faith and by the grace of God's Spirit was he upheld.
days of old: That is, your great benefits of old, and the manifold examples of your favour towards your own.
morning: That is, speedily and in due season.
cause me to know the way: Let your Holy Spirit counsel me how to come forth from these great cares and troubles.
I flee unto thee to hide: I hid myself under the shadow of your wings that I might be defended by your power.

Teach me to: He confesses that both the knowledge and obedience of God's will comes by the Spirit of God, who teaches us by his word, gives understanding by his Spirit, and frames our hearts by his grace to obey him.
do thy will: That is, justly and aright, for as soon as we decline from God's will, we fall into error.
cut off mine enemies: Which will be a sign of your fatherly kindness toward me.
servant: Resigning myself wholly to you, and trusting in your protection.
